notes.title: Beta Version Update.
notes.notes:
Now You can play beta version.

Check the "Beta" tab. by right clicking a game in your library, go to properties.

Boss Enemy Character is added in new map.

You can collect Coin from boss enemy.

Use the coin for upgrade.
